title: Value-Based Large Language Model Agent Simulation for Mutual Evaluation of Trust and Interpersonal Closeness

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring differences in value controllability using the Portrait Values Questionnaire (PVQ) and observing performance disparities (controllability scores) when LLMs are prompted to adopt specific personas in English versus Japanese.

Simulating value-based social interactions between LLM agents in English and Japanese environments to evaluate differences in mutual trust formation, interpersonal closeness (IOS), and adherence to culture-specific communication styles (e.g., conflict avoidance and response refusals in high-context Japanese culture).
